_what_this_is: The case the pair beside this one cannot carry: a repository that has published nothing, lowering a number nobody could ever have looked up. This is #180, refused by the older rule for not carrying an entry about a release that does not exist. It has to pass, and it has to say in the verdict that it passed for that reason. It is one document rather than a third member of the pair because a document is either about a repository that has published or about one that has not, and the release count is the only thing here excusing the change: delete that guard and this document is refused.
title: Start the version below 1.0, and move the one place that restates it (#180)
body:
Closes #180.

Nothing has shipped, so 1.0.0.0 is a claim rather than a number an operator has installed.
